The primary analysis workflow is DIA-based immunopeptidomics. Label-free quantification is inferred from the use of iRT normalization and peak area extraction without mention of isotopic tags.

scope: The pHLA complexes were immunoaffinity purified from the cell lysate supernatant using either the HLA-A*02:01-specific antibody BB7.2 (ATCC HB-82, grown and purified in-house) or the pan-HLA I antibody W6/32 (ATCC HB-95, grown and purified in-house) crosslinked to protein A sepharose
Microscale immunoprecipitation of thermally treated pHLA complexes was then carried out by mixing cooled lysates with W6/32 antibody (400 μg per replicate) bound to protein A sepharose
The pHLA complexes were immunoaffinity purified from the cell lysate supernatant and eluted with 10% acetic acid.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a specialized immunopeptidomics experiment. The primary goal is to generate thermostability (melting) curves for MHC-bound peptides. The analysis is peptide-centric (8-11 amino acids) and requires a spectral library-based DIA approach. The differential analysis is not a standard case-control comparison but a biophysical curve fitting (Tm) across a temperature gradient.
